proposal.scope_review: The learner drives an ordinary passenger car. The teaching point concerns that car driver’s route, road-sign interpretation or conduct; no specialist vehicle operation is taught.
proposal.scenario: Approach to ordinary suburban four-way intersection in France, visible straight continuation and right and left branches. Round blue sign on right before junction has a WHITE vertical upward arrow with a second arrow branching horizontally RIGHT, matching reference. No other directional signs, no traffic signals, car remains well before junction.
proposal.novelty_review: Two permitted directions including straight, not existing single mandatory straight or single turn.

fr.question_text: Quelles directions ce panneau autorise-t-il à la prochaine intersection ?
fr.explanation: Le panneau B21d1 permet de continuer tout droit ou de tourner à droite à la prochaine intersection. Tourner à gauche ne fait pas partie des directions indiquées ; je prépare la manœuvre choisie sans oublier la priorité.

en.question_text: Which directions does this sign permit at the next intersection?
en.explanation: Sign B21d1 permits continuing straight ahead or turning right at the next intersection. A left turn is not among the indicated directions; I prepare my chosen manoeuvre while observing priority rules.

review_note: Actual image reviewed: round blue sign with white up arrow and right branch before four-way junction; directions match B21d1. B alone is correct in French and English, with no invented priority.
